breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect gravity vector 'g (-9.81 0 0)' from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires 'g (0 0 -9.81)' since the height is along the Z-axis and gravity must act vertically downward to drive Rayleigh-Bénard convection. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
